qualification.details: Educational Counsellor: B.A/ B.Sc (Psychology) with certificate/ diploma in counselling. Desirable: Minimum one year experience in career/ educational counselling or working knowledge in placement bureaus or Registration with Rehabilitation Council of India as Vocational Counsellor. Work Experience Teacher: Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering/ Electronics Engineering/ Electronics & Communication Engineering with at least 50% marks. B.Ed with at least 50% marks from NCTE recognized institution. Proficiency to teach through Hindi and English. Knowledge of Computer Applications. Vocational Instructor: B.E./ B.Tech/ M.Tech (Electronic & Communication Engineering). TGT Special Educator: Graduation Degree. B.Ed (Special Education) with at least 50% marks or B.Ed (General) with at least 50% marks along with one/ two year Diploma in Special Education or equivalent qualifications approved by RCI. Qualified in CTET (Elementary Stage). Registration with RCI with valid CRR number.

content_sections.heading: PM SHRI KV Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for PM SHRI KV Bhubaneswar Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for PM SHRI KV Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Teachers posts at PM Shri Kendriya Vidyalaya Bhubaneswar is scheduled for 17 September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. What are the different posts advertised by PM SHRI KV Bhubaneswar?
faq.answer: PM SHRI KV Bhubaneswar has advertised for the posts of Vocational Instructor, Educational Counsellor, Work Experience Teacher, and TGT Special Educator. These are contractual positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts is 65 years as on 31 March 2026. No specific age relaxation details are provided in the summary.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the PM SHRI KV Bhubaneswar recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for these contractual posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these contractual positions at PM SHRI KV Bhubaneswar will involve a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates need to perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications for the TGT Special Educator post?
faq.answer: For the TGT Special Educator post, candidates need a Graduation Degree, B.Ed (Special Education) or B.Ed (General) with a Diploma in Special Education, and must have qualified CTET (Elementary Stage) and be registered with RCI.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at PM Shri Kendriya Vidyalaya Bhubaneswar. The exact venue address and reporting time will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and category certificates (if applicable), along with recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. Are these posts permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: The recruitment for these Teacher posts at PM Shri Kendriya Vidyalaya Bhubaneswar is on a contractual basis. This means the employment will be for a fixed tenure.
